intro: An exiled Atal'ai in the Hinterlands has looked over the artifacts brought to them and calls them harmless. They have darker worries about Jammal'an the Prophet, and Fel'zerul in Stonard is to hear them.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Jammal'an the Prophet sentenced me to exile from The Temple of Atal'Hakkar. I once felt the high priest was a worthy leader.
His unyielding faith in his prophecy will bring about the destruction of the Atal'ai. If it hasn't already.
When I expressed my concerns, I was labeled an infidel and ousted from the temple.
Those artifacts you brought to me are harmless. But if Jammal'an has found the proper fetish enchantment for the summoning ritual, the world lies in great peril....

clips.title: Completion
paras: It has been quite some time since we spoke, adventurer. I hope your journey was successful.
What knowledge did you gain from the exiled Atal'ai in the Hinterlands?
